'''Tomatoes''' are a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Strength}}. They replace {{MCW|Beetroot|beetroots}}. Eaten raw, they heal {{Value|Tomatoes|heals}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/tomato.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Farming ===
Tomatoes grow from [[Tomato Seeds|tomato seeds]] like beetroots. A fully grown crop drops 1 to 3 tomatoes and no seeds; an unripe one drops 1 seed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/beetroots.json}}</ref> Seeds are made by crafting a tomato into 3 seeds.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating tomatoes heals {{Value|Tomatoes|heals}}.

Picking up tomatoes unlocks [[Grilled Tomatoes|grilled tomatoes]], [[Sun-dried Tomatoes|sun-dried tomatoes]], [[bruschetta]] and [[Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|kontomire-dandelion stew]]. Tomatoes are also used in the [[Pizza|pizzas]], [[Paneer Curry Stock|paneer curry stock]] and 2 tomatoes make 2 red dye. The vanilla beetroot-to-red-dye recipe is removed.

== Trivia ==
* The loot table applies Fortune and the Electrum tool intrinsic and then sets the count to 1 to 3, which overrides both bonuses, so neither actually increases the harvest.
